ideas.truth: We miss the quiet care of a grandmother's small rituals in the rush of modern life.
ideas.moment: A young professional pauses at the kitchen counter before rushing out, filling her copper bottle exactly the way Dadi used to every morning.
ideas.key_frame: Close, warm-lit shot of hands filling a gleaming copper bottle at a marble counter at sunrise, calm space above for the headline.

ideas.truth: Traditional wisdom (Ayurveda, grandmothers' remedies) still feels more trustworthy than modern shortcuts.
ideas.moment: Dadi herself, at night, placing the copper bottle by the bedside — the origin ritual, passed down, now sold as a product.
ideas.key_frame: An elderly hand setting the copper bottle on a rustic wooden nightstand under warm lamp light, cozy and timeless.

ideas.truth: Real craftsmanship and purity don't need a story told around them — they speak for themselves.
ideas.moment: The bottle alone, catching first light on a stone kitchen counter, water droplets on its surface.
ideas.key_frame: Single hero shot of the copper bottle on a stone counter in soft morning light, clean copy space above.

why: It directly dramatizes the headline with a specific, relatable daily moment — nostalgic but contemporary — making the ad emotionally sticky while still being unmistakably product-forward for a feed scroll.
treatment: We open on a softly lit modern kitchen at sunrise. A young Indian woman stands at a marble counter, both hands around a gleaming copper bottle, mid-pour as morning light catches the metal. Blurred behind her: a tiffin box, a chai cup — hints of the daily rush. Her expression is unhurried, almost reverent, like the pause Dadi used to take filling this same kind of bottle every morning. The frame feels warm, slightly sepia-kissed, nostalgic yet shot with clean modern editorial polish. Above and to the left of her, a soft out-of-focus wall gives calm, uncluttered space where the headline will sit. Below, a quiet strip near the bottom holds the brand name, product line, and price. Nothing shouts; the mood is intimate and trustworthy — a single still that feels less like an ad and more like a remembered morning.

scenes.prompt: A studio reference photo of a gleaming pure copper water bottle, cylindrical with a gently tapered neck, flawless mirror-polished rose-gold copper finish, a matching copper screw cap with a fine ridged grip, smooth unblemished surface, capacity 1 litre, standing upright and centered on a clean matte white backdrop, soft frontal lighting creating a bright highlight along the body, a soft reflection on the white surface beneath, style: minimalist product photography, sharp focus, e-commerce quality, high resolution.
scenes.first_frame_still_prompt: Same as prompt — this scene is itself a single still, used only as the fixed product reference for scene 2.
